goal: Replace _mock_answer() with actual Anthropic Claude API calls. Every AI response comes from Claude with proper prompt engineering, token tracking, and fallback.

stories.title: Add Anthropic SDK dependency to AI service
stories.description: Add `anthropic>=0.40.0` to services/ai/pyproject.toml dependencies section. Verify pip install succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: anthropic>=0.40.0 listed in [project.dependencies] in pyproject.toml
pip install -e . succeeds without errors in the ai service container
python -c 'import anthropic' executes without ImportError

stories.title: Create async Claude client wrapper with retry and rate limiting
stories.description: Build a reusable async Claude client at services/ai/src/claude_client.py. Must handle: initialization from env var, message sending with structured JSON output, exponential backoff on rate limits (429), timeout handling (30s default), token usage counting per call, and per-tenant budget caps.
acceptance_criteria: ClaudeClient class initializes with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from environment
send_message() returns structured response with content, token_usage (input_tokens, output_tokens), and model fields
Rate limit (429) responses trigger exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, max 3 retries
Timeout set to 30s by default, configurable
Token usage logged per call with tenant_id for cost tracking
APIError, RateLimitError, APITimeoutError caught and handled with appropriate error responses
Client is async (uses anthropic.AsyncAnthropic)

stories.title: Build TPRM questionnaire prompt templates
stories.description: Create domain-specific prompt templates at services/ai/src/prompts.py for TPRM questionnaire answering. System prompt enforces structured JSON output. Includes vendor context injection (name, domain, tier, certifications), evidence context (parsed extractions), and question-specific prompting. Confidence scoring based on evidence availability.
acceptance_criteria: QUESTIONNAIRE_SYSTEM_PROMPT defined with role, output format (JSON), and TPRM domain context
build_autofill_prompt(vendor_context, evidence_context, questions) returns formatted user message
Prompt includes vendor profile fields: name, domain, tier, certifications, data_classification
Prompt includes evidence summary when available
Output schema enforces: {question_id, answer, confidence (0.0-1.0), reasoning, evidence_citations[]}
Confidence scoring rules documented: 0.9+ with evidence, 0.6-0.8 from public info, 0.3-0.5 inference only
Batch prompt template handles up to 10 questions per API call

stories.title: Replace _mock_answer() with real Claude calls in AIService
stories.description: Refactor AIService.auto_fill_assessment() in services/ai/src/service.py to use the ClaudeClient and prompt templates. Remove _mock_answer(). Batch questions into groups of 10 for API efficiency. Track total token usage in DB. Implement fallback: if Claude API fails after retries, log error and mark response as low-confidence rather than failing the entire batch.
acceptance_criteria: _mock_answer() function removed from service.py
auto_fill_assessment() calls ClaudeClient.send_message() with built prompts
Questions batched into groups of 10 for API calls
Each response includes: answer text, confidence score, reasoning, evidence citations
Token usage persisted to auto_fill_usage table with tenant_id, assessment_id, tokens_in, tokens_out
If Claude API fails: log error, return response with confidence=0.1 and note='AI service unavailable, manual review required'
Existing /ai/auto-fill endpoint continues to work with same request/response schema
Review queue items generated for confidence < 0.7

stories.title: Integration tests for Claude API auto-fill
stories.description: Create comprehensive tests at services/ai/tests/test_claude_integration.py. Unit tests mock the Anthropic client. Integration tests use real API (gated by ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var). Test: successful fill, API timeout fallback, rate limit handling, token tracking accuracy, batch processing, low-confidence fallback, review queue generation.
acceptance_criteria: At least 8 test cases covering: success, timeout, rate limit, token tracking, batching, fallback, confidence thresholds, review queue
Unit tests mock anthropic.AsyncAnthropic and run without API key
Integration tests (marked @pytest.mark.integration) use real API when key available
All unit tests pass: pytest services/ai/tests/ -v
Test coverage for claude_client.py, prompts.py, and modified service.py lines >= 80%
conftest.py updated with Claude client fixtures
